additional_context: The exact DAF CVX ValueSet source moved from source/immunization to the DAF guide area and was later deleted by d451dd0741c0ea6435ebd305a93dea623c62a335. Current non-history source has no valueset-daf-cvx or old generated phrase; the active CVX-related source is the Immunization vaccine-code ValueSet and terminology system table, which identify CVX directly.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical generator fix already addressed the issue, the obsolete DAF CVX artifact is not current FHIR-core source, and current active source does not contain the confusing wording.
